overview.description: SBJITMR actively facilitates numerous Central and State Government scholarships, concession schemes, and institutional memorial scholarships for all eligible categories to ensure affordable education.

government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: Government of India (GOI) Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
government_scholarship_schemes.benefit: 100% Tuition Fee + 100% Development Fee + Exam Fee reimbursed

government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: Swadhar Scheme (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Swadhar Yojna)
government_scholarship_schemes.benefit: ₹60,000 per year for food and lodging allowance
government_scholarship_schemes.where_to_apply: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department (MahaDBT)

government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: GOI Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
government_scholarship_schemes.benefit: 100% Tuition Fee + 100% Development Fee + Exam Fee

government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: Swayam Yojna (Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Swayam Yojna)
government_scholarship_schemes.benefit: ₹60,000 per year for accommodation & meal support

government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: Post-Matric Tuition Fee Freeship for OBC
Post-Matric Scholarship for VJNT & SBC Students
Tuition Fee Freeship for VJNT & SBC
Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)

government_scholarship_schemes.category: Religious Minority (Muslim, Jain, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist)
government_scholarship_schemes.benefit: ₹25,000/- per annum for State OR ₹25,000/- per annum for Central

government_scholarship_schemes.category: Wards of Primary & Secondary School Teachers
government_scholarship_schemes.where_to_apply: Manual form submission at College Student Section

government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students

government_scholarship_schemes.category: Children of Marginal Farmers & Registered Laborers
government_scholarship_schemes.scheme: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vastigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna (Hostel Maintenance)

institutional_scholarships.name: Sir Shantilal Badjate (SSB) Memorial Scholarship
institutional_scholarships.description: Offered by Sir Shantilal Badjate Charitable Trust to support financially deserving and meritorious students studying at SBJITMR.
institutional_scholarships.application_mode: Prescribed application form available at the College Administrative Section.

college_scholarship_section_contact.office: Scholarship & Student Section, Ground Floor, Administrative Block, SBJITMR
